name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: A textarea that grows smoothly to fit its text, with a rolling character counter and an error that slides in.

useCases: Comments, feedback, and chat composers that should start small and grow with the text instead of showing a scrollbar early.
Bios and posts with a character limit, where a rolling counter warns as the limit gets close.
limitations: Height follows the text between minRows and maxRows; manual resizing is turned off. The counter needs maxLength and counts UTF-16 code units, like the native limit.
Rows are measured from the textarea's own font and padding, so classes that change them should be applied to the component source rather than to className.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, and theme colors including destructive. Supply label or aria-label. Controlled usage requires updating value in onValueChange. Reduced motion resizes instantly and skips the counter shake.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/textarea.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
